changeSet.comment: nexus.assign_from_chashes_384: centroid branch now persists source_collection (= p_collection, already in scope); layered CREATE OR REPLACE over vectors-005-16, no other line changed
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.assign_from_chashes_384( p_collection text, p_chashes text[], p_cross_collection boolean ) RETURNS TABLE( chash text, topic_id bigint, similarity double precision ) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ #variable_conflict use_column BEGIN IF p_cross_collection THEN INSERT INTO nexus.catalog_collections (tenant_id, name) VALUES (current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), p_collection) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, name) DO NOTHING;
RETURN QUERY WITH nearest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.chash) encode(c.chash, 'hex') AS m_chash, ct.topic_id AS m_topic_id, (1 - (c.embedding_384 <=> ct.embedding_384))::double precision AS m_sim FROM nexus.chunks c JOIN nexus.taxonomy_centroids ct ON ct.collection <> p_collection AND ct.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL WHERE c.collection = p_collection AND c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL AND c.chash = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT decode(x, 'hex') FROM unnest(p_chashes) x)) ORDER BY c.chash, (c.embedding_384 <=> ct.embedding_384) ASC, ct.collection ASC, ct.topic_id ASC ), persisted AS ( INSERT INTO nexus.topic_assignments AS ta (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id, assigned_by, similarity, assigned_at, source_collection) SELECT current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, 'projection', n.m_sim, now(), p_collection FROM nearest n ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id) DO UPDATE SET similarity = GREATEST(COALESCE(ta.similarity, -1.0), EXCLUDED.similarity), assigned_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.similarity > COALESCE(ta.similarity, -1.0) THEN EXCLUDED.assigned_at ELSE ta.assigned_at END, source_collection = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.similarity > COALESCE(ta.similarity, -1.0) THEN EXCLUDED.source_collection ELSE ta.source_collection END, assigned_by = 'projection' RETURNING 1 ) SELECT n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, n.m_sim FROM nearest n; ELSE RETURN QUERY WITH nearest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.chash) encode(c.chash, 'hex') AS m_chash, ct.topic_id AS m_topic_id, (1 - (c.embedding_384 <=> ct.embedding_384))::double precision AS m_sim FROM nexus.chunks c JOIN nexus.taxonomy_centroids ct ON ct.collection = p_collection AND ct.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL WHERE c.collection = p_collection AND c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL AND c.chash = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT decode(x, 'hex') FROM unnest(p_chashes) x)) ORDER BY c.chash, (c.embedding_384 <=> ct.embedding_384) ASC, ct.topic_id ASC ), persisted AS ( INSERT INTO nexus.topic_assignments (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id, assigned_by, source_collection) SELECT current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, 'centroid', p_collection FROM nearest n ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1 ) SELECT n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, NULL::double precision FROM nearest n; END IF; END; $fn$;
